evidence.sequence_semantics: Hamming on aligned sequences; literal motifs and composition on ungapped sequences
evidence.model_support_validation: Candidate support enforced; assays outside prior support annotated
evidence.scientific_claim: Negative Potts energy is a model score proxy; no measured function claim
evidence.optimization_scope: Top utility capped candidate pool; optimality applies only to this pool

compiled_batch_objective.kind: Finite penalty export for an optimization objective; not a physical device execution
compiled_batch_objective.quadratic_pair_convention: Each pair i < j counted once
compiled_batch_objective.bit_to_spin: s = 2*z - 1; False maps to -1 and True maps to +1
compiled_batch_objective.sampling_note: Finite penalties permit infeasible thermal samples; decode and check every returned state
compiled_batch_objective.hardware_status: Simulation specification only; dense graph embedding and device coefficient limits unverified

solver.block_schedule: One singleton spin block per candidate, sequential order
solver.budget_scope: Bounded draw and warmup counts; JAX compilation and sampling calls are synchronous and not interrupted
solver.claim_scope: Optimization heuristic with feasible sample filtering and a separately labelled classical incumbent; no equilibrium sampling claim
